entities.summary: Henrik Hololei is an Estonian civil servant and former politician. He served as director-general for mobility and transport of the European Commission from 2015 to 2023, then as a senior adviser in the commission's Directorate-General for International Partnerships. He previously served as Estonia's minister of economic affairs in the second cabinet led by Mart Laar.
